verdict.rationale: Adyen docs explicitly describe a testing system for POS integrations, including ordering a test card from the test Customer Area, testing different card brands/CVMs/declined payments, and a basic simulation system for transaction scenarios—directly matching the story of end-to-end testing before going live. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer confirmation of the test workflow's completeness or fidelity, and no mention of a fully simulated reader emulator beyond the test card/basic simulator.
